description:
Several pages are mid-redesign in the working tree and should be finished rather than committed half-done.

In flight: /profile/api-keys, /profile/notification-channels (both the content and explainer partials), /settings/profile via the settings hub, /profile/source-control, and the /features marketing page, which was flagged as doing too much. Also the first-load theme default, where resources/js/theme.js was deleted in favour of the inline theme-head partial — verify it no longer flashes light before settling.

Roughly 50 view files are touched. The user tests these manually in the browser.
title: Finish the settings and marketing redesigns
